On v=Kz^(m+1), K=B/[4(m+1)], derivative v−Kz^(m+1) is ≥−z^(2n−1)+KB z^(2m+1)/4>0 for sufficiently large z; z=R border points inward. Thus all starting wedge data remain inside, with ż≥Kz^(m+1), forcing finite forward lifespan and divergence; if z stayed bounded v solves bounded-coefficient linear equation, contradicting maximality. As z increases, dv/dz=ẇb(z)−z^(2n−1)/v, leading v~Az^(m+1), A=B/(m+1), and the first correction Q=[c−1_{m=n}/A]/(m−1); restoring term is lower order for m>n and exactly resonant for m=n. Tail integral τ=∫_z^∞dζ/v(ζ) yields τ=Lz^(−m)−Q/[A²(m+2)]z^(−m−2)+o, L=1/(Am). Independent symbolic inversion checked z=(L/τ)^(1/m)−Q/[A(m+2)](τ/L)^(1/m)+o.
